title: ATLAS
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail

music.tags: epic battle orchestra, taiko drums, war choir, heavy low brass, string ostinato, massive, instrumental

beats.prompt: A worn canvas backpack on a rock at altitude, wide mountain light behind, cinematic, weathered texture
beats.motion: Wind moves the straps. Cloud drifts behind.
beats.caption: Nine years old

line.text: This pack is nine years old.

beats.prompt: Close-up of frayed but intact stitching on a canvas strap, hard side light, texture detail
beats.motion: Light travels slowly across the stitching.
beats.caption: Doubled where others tear

line.text: The stitching is doubled where every other pack tears first.

beats.prompt: The pack being lifted onto shoulders, seen from behind, dawn light on a mountain trail, cinematic
beats.motion: The pack lifts and settles onto the shoulders.
beats.caption: Heavier. That is the trade.

line.text: It is heavier than the light ones. That is the trade, and we are not going to pretend otherwise.

beats.prompt: The pack silhouetted against a bright sky at a summit, wide shot, triumphant light
beats.motion: Wind moves the straps against the sky.
beats.caption: ATLAS - buy it once
